_description: Paper-profit overlay for net-PnL validation. Separates profit-seeking paper runs from sample-collection runs.

alpha_gate._description: Profit profile keeps net-positive filtering but allows medium-edge paper intents instead of empty rounds.

confidence_gate._description: Still stricter than baseline, but no longer blocks medium-confidence paper profit setups by default.

drl._description: Allow DRL to contribute to exits in profit-mode paper runs without granting entry authority.

gambler._description: Disable high-risk heavy-bet overrides in paper profit mode; keep paper fills driven by alpha/risk gates instead.

structure_gate._description: Keep fractal breakout as the preferred trigger, but allow reduced-size paper entries when an OPPORTUNITY setup is already close to the break and net edge is clearly positive.

weekend_manager._description: Weekend paper-profit stays capped, but no longer hard-requires 66bps for every OPPORTUNITY entry.
